scope: Released banker/slot callbacks and GUI routing, with an inherited vanilla merge comparison and252 bounded arithmetic models. Static evidence identifies risk candidates; it is not a reproduced Forge/modpack transaction or a confirmed current Enderloom defect.

transaction_model.scope: Assumes a valid matching output stack, a successful inherited merge moving up to the stated capacity,then the exact fixed-debit/recompute callback. It does not model every Forge hook,click type,network state or save.
